summary.executive_summary: The audit evaluated 49 requirements across the transfer and transaction history features, with 27 passing, 11 failing, and 11 unverified. Three critical defects were identified: the system accepts zero and negative transfer amounts and allows transfers that exceed available account balance, all while displaying success messages and creating completed transactions. Five major defects were also found, including incorrect handling of recoverable errors, missing amounts in transaction history rows, and date-range filtering that excludes boundary dates despite inclusive specification. The audit completed in 195.9 seconds at a cost of $0.10.

The seed record exists and the filter fails on a single-day inclusive range, so the failure is not explained by the environment.
